dct_description_sm: Lake dataset created to be used as part of the Water Resources dataset for the Regional Official Plan. ROP Consolidation September 3, 2024.This dataset was created based on the direction provided by the Conservation Authority Working Group, in defining “Lakes and their Littoral Zones”. Data was pulled from MNRF, LSRCA, and TRCA datasets to create this layer.
